tools.name: make_dashboard_from_file
tools.description: Turn a spreadsheet export (Excel or CSV, up to 10 MB) into an Every Number dashboard. Returns a read-only dashboard link and every number on it with its receipt: the definition, the rows it used, and the rows it left out with the reason. Fixed rules lay out the screen and a database counts every num

tools.name: verify_numbers
tools.description: Check every number in a piece of text (a report, an email, a summary, or an answer you wrote) against the spreadsheet it came from. Each number is counted again from the file and comes back as matches, counted_differently, differs (with the value the file gives) or not_checked, each with how it was

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "make_dashboard_from_file" appears informational but accepts parameters (file_content) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_numbers · Private data: make_dashboard_from_file, verify_numbers · Public sink: make_dashboard_from_file, verify_numbers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_numbers · Private data: make_dashboard_from_file, verify_numbers · Public sink: make_dashboard_from_file, verify_numbers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
